mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, url, description, category, sort_order, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM personal_bookmarks WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY sort_order ASC, created_at ASC
SELECT id, user_id, title, url, description, category, sort_order, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM personal_bookmarks WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO personal_bookmarks (user_id, title, url, description, category, sort_order) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{url}, #{description}, #{category}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE personal_bookmarks SET title = #{title}, url = #{url}, description = #{description}, category = #{category}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE personal_bookmarks SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
